glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a bladed tool to plow the ground and to mark a border. As an alternative, a carpenter's square; according to the second interpretation, the character is related to the original meaning of 巨. Unrelated to 巠 > 𢀖 and 壬.
senses: [gōng] (regional, dialectal, including, Southeast Asia) work; job; profession
